# Image Region

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](gmeow-ImageRegion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ImageRegion>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

A region within an image — a structural part of a [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md), described by a [`gmeow:RegionSelector`](gmeow-RegionSelector.md) that encodes its boundaries. The counterpart of [`ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md) for visual media: a face, an object bounding box, a polygon, or a pixel mask. Carries a human-readable [`gmeow:regionLabel`](../properties/gmeow-regionLabel.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](gmeow-ImageRegion.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
